========================================================================
AT_01 – GERAÇÃO DO TOKEN DE SESSÃO
------------------------------------------------------------------------
COMO PEGAR: POST /v1/auth | Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded | body grant_type + client_id + client_secret | mTLS (.crt+.key)

Request enviado (referência):
{
  "grant_type": "client_credentials",
  "client_id": "3cbe1db9-ee03-4f3b-aae4-b0ea2e649cee",
  "client_secret": "jHM5711Cz2O6RHVpD79QKlqyhJipDyGf"
}

>>> Status Code - Retornado:
200

>>> Response Body - Retornado (cole no documento):
{
  "access_token": "",
  "expires_in": 600,
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "scope": "payloadlocationrec.write payloadlocationrec.read receivable.read checkout.read cobv.write schedulepayments.write cobr.read webhook.read pix.read bankslip.write v2.bankslip.write solicrec.write cobr.write solicrec.read statement.read lotecobv.write bankslip.read recpayload.read checkout.write payloadlocation.write v2.bankslip.pix.write schedulepayments.read lotecobv.read rec.read webhook.write cob.read v2.bankslip.read pix.write cob.write checkout.cancel cobv.read rec.write checkout.keys.read payloadlocation.read"
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------
